status: Measured licensed phone-photo holdout benchmark; semantic adjudication pending

dataset.name: SNAPMe
dataset.limitation: Licensed external phone photos, not owned product captures; visible identity only; no post-holdout tuning.

configuration.grading: strict normalized exact label or pre-approved alias match

semantic_adjudication.policy: One-to-one human judgment against the independently reviewed visible labels. Only MATCH counts as correct; a visible label cannot be reused within a case.

interpretation: The strict lexical F1 of 0.371 is a reproducible lower bound. Twenty-one non-exact predictions still require independent one-to-one semantic adjudication before a semantic holdout score can be reported.
